_doc: PHASE-0 FIREWALL. A topic seeded from a published comparator can never be scored against that comparator. Topics listed in scored_topics are EXCLUDED from comparator seeding. Comparator works listed in scored_comparator_dois are EXCLUDED from use as seeds. Both sets are declared before any reference list is fetched.

rule.seedable: a topic is seedable iff norm(topic) not in scored_topics
rule.usable_as_seed: a published MA is usable as a seed iff its DOI not in scored_comparator_dois
rule.provenance: every trial entering the corpus via this route carries found_via='FOUND_VIA_COMPARATOR' and seed_source_pmcid/seed_source_doi, and is never counted as our own search yield
